assumptions.assumption: Actual MP1 packing replaces helical published geometries
assumptions.required_check: Measure as-built wire count, diameters, contact neighbors, clearances and initial curvature; test sensitivity to packing realization.

assumptions.assumption: Pressure acts on fluid-wetted membrane as boundary traction, not directly as known interwire normal force
assumptions.required_check: Measure membrane deformation and independently bound p-to-contact transfer; propagate uncertainty.
assumptions.evidence_pointer: Tjahjanto analytical Eq. (6) and radial-pressure FE load case

assumptions.assumption: NiTi law includes transformation state/history and temperature dependence
assumptions.required_check: Calibrate on single wires with load/unload and temperature sweeps; verify update algorithm.

assumptions.assumption: Contact topology and Coulomb law are an adequate first existing-physics interface description
assumptions.required_check: Calibrate friction in direct shear/pull-out across normal loads, temperature and cycling; inspect wear/adhesion effects.

assumptions.assumption: Finite bending and local section deformation can be resolved by 3D mesh
assumptions.required_check: Mesh/element and increment convergence; section-shape measurements.
assumptions.evidence_pointer: Tjahjanto geometrically nonlinear FE; Vahidi 3D solids

assumptions.assumption: Vahidi symmetric tensile/compressive response transfers to MP1 bending
assumptions.required_check: Check separate wire tension/compression or appropriate bending calibration; select existing asymmetric law before lock if needed.
S02 rate/temperature pilot must bound heat effects; else add coupled thermal branch.
assumptions.evidence_pointer: Vahidi temperature-dependent constitutive terms; W02 GAP-06

assumptions.assumption: Friction and pressure transmission are separately identifiable
assumptions.required_check: Use independent shear/pull-out and membrane/section tests; retain covariance/intervals; stop if compensation reverses verdict.

assumptions.assumption: Published rope boundary conditions transfer to specimen clamps/prestrain
assumptions.required_check: Measure fixture compliance, end slip and prestrain; include as physical parameters, not adjustment knobs.
assumptions.evidence_pointer: Vahidi Section 4 end coupling; Tjahjanto applied axial strain

assumptions.assumption: Barsi uniform slip-state bounds are usable as consistency checks
assumptions.required_check: Compare FE limiting states only within Barsi small-deformation, short-rope assumptions; do not use as transition prediction.

assumptions.assumption: A physically absent new coupling term has been identified
assumptions.required_check: No such term has been demonstrated in current repository evidence; leave claim unmade pending later locked forward discrimination.
